caption: Stones of Revision
lines: Open your inventory and drag one Revision Hammer onto one unequipped weapon, armor piece, ring or trinket.
The hammer and the selected equipment are consumed. You receive Stones of Revision in your inventory.
Weapons yield 4 plus a random amount up to grade / 10. Armor yields 2 plus that random amount. Rings and trinkets yield one stone.
This conversion is performed in the inventory; the blacksmith does not have a separate destruction window.
